# Skill Install Tests

exec mkdir -p $WORK/skills

# --- Install skill without --location fails ---
! exec akb skill install kb-management
stderr '--location is required'

# --- Install skill to temp directory ---
exec akb skill install --location $WORK/skills kb-management

# --- Verify SKILL.md extracted ---
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/SKILL.md
! stderr .

# --- Verify references directory extracted ---
exec test -d $WORK/skills/kb-management/references
! stderr .

# --- Verify reference files exist ---
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/references/INIT.md
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/references/INGEST.md
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/references/QUERY.md
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/references/UPDATE.md
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/references/MAINTAIN.md
exec test -f $WORK/skills/kb-management/references/APPROVE.md

# --- Install same skill again fails ---
! exec akb skill install --location $WORK/skills kb-management
stderr 'already installed'

# --- Install unknown skill fails ---
! exec akb skill install --location $WORK/skills nonexistent
stderr 'Unknown skill'
